2608.18726.title: Execution-grounded evaluation reveals hidden failures in language-model calculations for environmental science
2608.18726.paper_summary: Large language models are increasingly used for quantitative work in the environmental sciences, yet existing evaluations score only final answers, leaving calculation process unobserved. Here we introduce AtmosCoder-Bench, an execution-grounded benchmark that makes the calculation process visible. Built through a transferable semi-automated pipeline (436 problems, 3,910 variants, 7,029 graded quantities), every problem is validated to be unambiguous and human-solvable, with uniquely verifiable answers. We find that (i) multiple-choice formats inflate measured accuracy by at least 12 percentage points; (ii) many failures arise not from missing knowledge but from models failing to apply known formulas and constraints consistently throughout multi-step computation; and (iii) even frontier models remain weak when task-specific conditions invalidate familiar methods, often reverting to canonical solution patterns rather than adapting methods to the relevant physical regime, leaving expert oversight essential.
2608.18726.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型在環境科學的定量工作中越來越被使用，然而現有的評估僅評分最終答案，計算過程卻未被觀察到。這裡我們介紹 AtmosCoder-Bench，一個基於執行的基準，使計算過程可見。通過一個可轉移的半自動化流程（436 個問題，3,910 個變體，7,029 個評分數量）構建，每個問題都經過驗證，確保其明確且可由人類解決，並擁有獨特可驗證的答案。我們發現 (i) 多選格式使測量的準確性至少提高了 12 個百分點；(ii) 許多失敗並非因為缺乏知識，而是因為模型未能在多步計算中始終如一地應用已知的公式和約束；以及 (iii) 即使是前沿模型在任務特定條件使熟悉的方法失效時仍然表現不佳，往往回歸到經典的解決模式，而不是將方法適應於相關的物理範疇，這使得專家的監督變得至關重要。
